content:
maria: ⚠️ Repro for weird KV cache mem growth / cross-request contamination on long contexts. Happening on canary; attaching logs and quick notes.

kai: Can you paste the logs? rough repro steps? :eyes:

maria: Log excerpt from canary (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-10T14:12:01Z] kv_page_alloc: page_id=0x7f2a size=8192 owner_req=0x7b1f offset=0
[2026-03-10T14:12:01Z] kv_write: req=0x7b1f token_idx=4095 write_len=512 page=0x7f2a page_off=4095
[2026-03-10T14:12:02Z] kv_evict: page=0x7f2a evicted_by=0x7b2e last_seq=4096
[2026-03-10T14:12:02Z] kv_reuse: page=0x7f2a reassign_to=0x7b3a expected_off=0 got_off=8  <-- mismatch
[2026-03-10T14:12:02Z] kv_read: req=0x7b3a token_idx=8 read_len=64 data_from_offset=0
```
This shows a page re-used with a wrong token offset — looks like stale data surfaced into a new request.

devin: Is this after the recent batching heuristic changes (v2)? We pushed that two days ago.

maria: yes, canary rolled v2 yesterday. But I can repro locally without that change by interleaving short requests with a long one. Seems timing-sensitive.

zara: I saw a similar symptom last week on a different cluster: stale KV blocks returned when a long context caused paging + eviction while small requests were queued. Not identical logs but behavior matches.

infra-bot: deploy bot: rollout "batching-heuristic/v2" finished on canary at 2026-03-09T22:03:12Z (ok)

kai: quick hypothesis: eviction/reuse path uses block_index and LRU timestamps, but we only zero header.owner_req on full eviction; partial evictions or fragmented pages can leave header.owner_req stale. Then allocate_page reuses it without checking request tag. Race when a page is split across appends.

aj: that matches an older bug we fixed in 2024 where fragmentation allowed cross-tenant leaks. Possible fix: tag pages with a monotonically-incrementing owner_epoch (u64) and check owner_epoch+offset mapping before reuse. If mismatch, treat as zombie and zero.

maria: I tried a small instrument patch: added a request_tag check at allocate time and assert on mismatch. Results: repro frequency dropped from 100% to ~0.1% on the local fuzz harness. Patch diff snippet: 
```cpp
// pseudo
if (page.owner_tag != req.tag || page.base_token_offset > expected_offset) {
  // force zero + refill to avoid cross-request data
  zero_page(page);
  page.owner_tag = req.tag;
}
```

devin: nice. Any perf regression from the extra check/zero? we need to be careful on hot paths.

maria: microbench numbers: zeroing a 8KB page adds ~0.03ms when it happens, but the check itself is cheap. The zero is rare (only on mismatch). On long workloads the extra zeros are negligible compared to the safety gains.

kai: still want a reproducible test in CI. I propose a stress harness that concurrently sends mixes of short and long contexts, with deliberate eviction pressure. Something like:
```
./tools/kv_fuzz --threads 48 --max-len 65536 --short-pct 60 --evict-pressure 80 --seed 20260310
```
This should reliably hit the race and prevent regressions.

zara: add a metric too: kv.cross_request_reuse_count and kv.page_owner_mismatch_count. If either >0 in production we alert.

maria: added local metric counters. On canary before patch counts were: kv.cross_request_reuse_count=312 in 30m; after patch-> 0.

devin: sound plan. Two things: (1) get a clean, minimal fix that avoids heavy zeroing on the critical path, (2) add CI fuzz test + metric + an alert on canary.

kai: implementation idea to avoid full-page zero: maintain per-page epoch + per-slot valid_mask of blocks. On reuse, if epochs mismatch, just reset valid_mask instead of full memset, fallback to full zero only if mask shows partial valid slots. This keeps hot-path cheap.

aj: remember to update serialization for on-disk/persisted pages (private deployments) — we need version bump so older pages won't be misinterpreted.

maria: profiling: flamegraph for the repro run attached: https://artifacts.redwood/pg/flamegraphs/1793001234/kv-repro.html - shows most contention in kv_evict + allocate_page spin loops.

devin: assign ownership to @kai (root fix) and @maria (tests + canary metrics). Please create PR with changelog and perf microbench.

kai: will pick up. I'll prototype epoch+mask approach and run the harness overnight.

maria: I'll open the fuzz CI job and add the alert rule. Also will drop a short PR with the assert + metric to validate in canary first.

zara: once patched let's run a 24h canary soak with heavy long-context traffic and monitor kv.cross_request_reuse_count and memory delta.

devin: thanks everyone. Please link PRs here. :rocket: 

maria: adding tasks to eng-runtime board now and will post PR links when ready.
